title: the FF magic item tables
audit_label: R848 FF magic item tables audit
audit_anchor: #include "rules/audits/r847_batch.h"  // R847: R847 FF encounter listings audit
audit_comment: THE FF MAGIC ITEM TABLES - the party magic bands and the four item tables of the print pp. 101-102 (the third and closing round of the three FF table-group rounds): the 13 Individual-is-Nth-level party bands (N 1-13, one percent-chance and count pair per offered item table, the percentage dropped at the automatic rows - Table I automatic from 10th, Table II from 12th, Table III at 13th) and the four die tables - Table I the d20 list (20 items: the potions, scrolls, rings, armor, shield, swords, arrows, bolts, dagger, javelin, mace), Table II the (d8, d6) list (16 items: the scroll, rings, staff, wands, bracers, brooch, cloak, dust, figurine, javelins, chainmail set, splint mail, sword, the weapons pair), Table III the (d8, d6) list (16 items: the ring, rod, staff, bag, boots, cloak, gauntlets, pipe, robe, the ropes pair, plate set, shield, sword, mace, spear) and Table IV the d12 list (12 items: the rings, rod, wand, cube, eyes, horn, robe, talisman, plate set, sword, arrow). THE WALK: 5 tables, 77 rows, every cell pinned (band percent, band count, roster ordinal, printed leading count; the roster ordinal walks the 64 distinct item labels in first-appearance order, Tables I through IV). THE SOURCES: the four-voice scan collation from the archive.org item tsr02012fiendfolio (the djvu text, the word-geometry xml, the abbyy char xml and the pdf hidden Acrobat Capture layer) with the DMG npcparty parity (the 1eonline transcription, its editorial angle-bracket notes ignored) the tie-breaker; the party bands walk the p. 101 prose twice (the top bands 6-13 and the bottom bands 1-5), the tables ride pp. 101-102. THE CENSUS PINS: 13 band rows, 64 item rows (20/16/16/12), 64 roster labels, ZERO registry defs touched - the item rows are not monster listings, no defs promoted, the registry floor holds at 995. THE REPAIRS (18, the R703 pattern): the party-prose garbles (Ittirm = Items, i item = 1 item, the Table i/M/ML/111/lit/1 name garbles, the (d8 n d6) header), the Table I garbles (41 = +1, the super-heroism comma, the ring protection +1 restored from the pdf Capture voice), the Table II garbles (chairman = chainmail), the Table III robe garble (b fending = blending), the Table IV garbles (the talisman of, the robe line-order split) and the pdf voice garbles (1 ,BLE = TABLE, sdint = splint). THE NOTED INK: the ring of protection +1 (both char voices drop the +1, the pdf Capture voice carries it, the DMG parity agrees), the FF dust of appearance against the DMG dust of disappearance (the FF ink pinned, the divergence noted), the +1 (or +2) et al dagger row without the DMG six-dagger footnote expansion, the closing prose (the personal-select advice and the groups-or-multiples note), the (d8, d6) linear convention (d6 1-3 reads the d8 result 1-8, d6 4-6 reads d8+8, 9-16 - the DMG linear-range dice convention), and the bands match the DMG listing exactly. No defs promoted this round - the registry floor holds at 995; the round closes the three-round FF table-group arc.
